ONTARIO CAMPS ASSOCIATION FONDS, 1988 ADDITIONS — TRENT UNIVERSITY ARCHIVES, 88-006
====================================================================================
Fetched raw and stripped of markup 2026-09-06 from https://archives.trentu.ca/index.php/88-006
Financial records, camp brochures, committee minutes, photographs and cassette recordings.
Languages: English and French. One of nine additions to 72-007 (with 78-006, 82-009, 84-019,
85-011, 86-018, 89-015, 92-005, 93-021).

WHY THIS MATTERS TO KANAWANA — Box 2, Folders 41-42 are the QUEBEC CAMPING ASSOCIATION (ENGLISH
SECTION) papers for 1972-1979, the section an anglophone YMCA camp in Quebec would appear in.
Box 2 Folder 20 is a FRENCH LANGUAGE CONFERENCE, QUEBEC, 1976. Box 2 Folder 22 is an ORAL
HISTORY PROJECT, 1976-1977.
